title: nrf_fuel_gauge process: nrf_model_process_43a698
approach: Bottom-up continuation after verified init. Typographic process (5076B) was extracted from cores.S, converted to .inst, and decompiled into scalar C with 4-wide MVE helpers (q_mul/q_add, VLD4/VST4) and delayed-vmrs CFG. Compared typographic process vs C process on Renode 1.17 M55, both using already-verified C callees (including C 43bb14). Not installed.

result.first_fail: soc stock=0 vs C=-0.05 (0xBD4CCCCD). One-case dump (init then process, v=3.2 i=0.05 T=0 dt=1 count=1): stock writes qNaN 0x7FC00000 through state[0x08..0x44] and state[0xC0/C4]; C writes -Inf/finite/0 instead. Also state+0x90/0xCC and opt[0]/opt[2] differ. Mid-function MVE/state+8 and 43bc84 residual path is not yet bit-exact.

43bb14_count_ge_4: Typographic process passes r8 = first 439fb4 result (0..3, three temp flags) to all three 43bb14 calls; it never calls 43bb14 with count>=4. Process-level harness still included state[0xB4] in {1,2,3,4,5,8} so 439ce0/memcpy sizes are exercised. Direct 43bb14 count=4..8 property checks were also present but are not a typographic golden.
not_done: C process is WIP in the test tree only (c-leaves/g2c_fuel_gauge_leaves.c and mid6_process.c). Production leaves/header/cores.S were not changed.
Do not install this body. cores.S still has typographic nrf_model_process_43a698.
